get_task_xml_path: get the xml path for a go1 task name like flat_terrain or rough_terrain
list_feet_sites: list the four foot site names for the Unitree Go1 quadruped robot
list_feet_geoms: list the four foot geom names for collision detection on the Go1 robot
get_feet_position_sensors: get the list of feet position sensor names derived from the Go1 foot sites
get_sensor_constants: get the sensor name constants for upvector, linvel, angvel, accelerometer, and gyro
